why: The reduced-motion form of the emptied pip's cue starts from a literal 5px border again (issue #1022's review). The same growth as `hud-css-pip-cue-starts-at-a-literal-border`, for half the cue instead of 30% of it and with no swell to hide it: a 9px pip's box grows to 10px and the strip shifts 1px (measured in Chromium). The stylesheet test reads the reduced-motion keyframe set as well as the motion one.
